entries.name: Vengeful Bastion
entries.flavor: Every blow that lands on this line comes back doubled, and the line has learned to smile through the pain.
entries.notes: Generated from an authored answer against promptVersion set-charm-gen/1. CORRECTED 2026-09-07 (found via the real FusionRpg.Core.Tests suite, not the narrower Python/ItemSeedValidator checks the original trial batch ran): every member now names a real, existing `baseType` (matching the established convention every other shipped set uses -- humanoid AND plant frame per role, 8 members total) instead of leaving the field unauthored. `SetCorpus.cs`'s own real, current loader treats `baseType` as required per member and refuses the WHOLE corpus file on its absence -- the original 'not resolved here, module 13 builds no chooser' framing was correct about WHO decides identity long-term, but wrong about the field being safely omittable today. IDs are real, existing base-types picked by (role, frame, band=a), matching the corpus's own band-a starter convention.
